sections.title: Simulation
sections.description: Control plane, NetSquid engine, and Docker runtime. NetSquid wheels need CPython 3.8–3.11 (usually 3.10).

fields.label: Runtime mode
fields.description: Local Python uses the selected interpreter. Docker publishes the same HTTP API on 127.0.0.1.

fields.label: Python interpreter
fields.description: Select a discovered interpreter or type a path. Compatible versions are highlighted. Mismatched versions cannot install NetSquid.

fields.label: NetSquid PyPI user
fields.description: Forum username. Used only to install the engine from pypi.netsquid.org.

fields.label: NetSquid PyPI password
fields.description: Forum password. Stored in OS secret storage, not settings.json.

fields.label: Index URL override
fields.description: Leave empty. Pip uses https://pypi.netsquid.org as the index.

fields.label: Docker image
fields.description: Leave empty to build certiqs-sim:local from the extension Dockerfile.

fields.label: Auto-start API
fields.description: Start the control plane when Run Control opens.

sections.title: Development
sections.description: The default debug compound is certiqs IDE (Hot Reload). It runs scripts/run-debug.sh, then attaches to the certiqs IDE inspect ports.

fields.label: certiqs IDE (Hot Reload)
fields.description: Default compound. scripts/run-debug.sh starts watch if needed and launches certiqs IDE on 5875/5870/5879/5878.

fields.label: Refresh extension host
fields.description: scripts/refresh-extensions.sh sim — compile certiqs-sim and restart the running certiqs IDE extension host.
